fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-04-15 at approximately 00:45, it was reported that a caller claiming to be a bank executive asked the complainant to install a support application, after which Rs. 45,000 was withdrawn. Vidhya Devi approached Tirunelveli Town PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000062. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Hariharan Palanisamy, using the number 9000000463. Chandran Krishnan (9000000031) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The complainant mentioned the account SYN-ACC-100073 as the destination of the transfer. Items referenced in the complaint: social media screenshots and digital documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Fraudulent KYC-update message allegedly used to collect account credentials.
fields.Keywords: phishing, suspicious link, witness, suspect, digital document, shopping complex, mobile number, night
